rationale: The November release row names .NET dual-mode runtime vulnerability detection. The language-specific guide requires one supported AppDynamics .NET Agent 26.9 dual-mode installation and no duplicate profiler, qualifies coverage to active AWS realms with Secure Application, and explicitly excludes GCP realms. Entitlement and customer authorization are separate.

products: Splunk Observability Cloud Secure Application / AppDynamics .NET Agent
deployments: Supported applications and active AWS Secure Application realms
exclusions: No realm-wide or regulated authorization and no generic .NET support is established.
